improvements: Caption should name the fishpond in the foreground and the ruined church beyond, and note the 1993 date.
grades.reason: Strongest choice: it shows both features named in the Examples text, the former fishpond and the ruined church, in their empty valley setting. That conveys desertion better than the church-only views.

improvements: Caption should mention the missing aisles and roofless tower, so readers don't mistake the church for an intact building.
grades.reason: A clear, well-lit view of St Martin's Church. Part of the nave still has a roof, so the ruin reads less obviously than in the interior view, and the deserted village setting is absent.

improvements: Use only as a second image beside the fishpond view, with a caption naming the roofless interior.
grades.reason: The open sky through the roofless interior shows the ruin unmistakably. It covers only the church, not the fishpond or village site, and partly duplicates the other church view.
